name: Hinomori Shizuku
source:
Shizuku is a former member of the idol group Cheerful✽Days. Her fans are left in awe of her mysterious and adult-like appearance. However, this makes the other members of her group jealous of her. She was an idol trainee at the same time as [url=/c128192]Airi[/url].

She's part of the idol unit MORE MORE JUMP!.

[From in-game profile]
